product.name: Bunbird
product.shortDescription: Build and publish small web apps
product.packageDescription: Build small web apps with an AI agent, preview them with no account, and publish them from your Bunbird account, through two hosted MCP servers.
product.longDescription: Bunbird is an agent-first platform for small web apps made for a group of people, with sign-in, data, files, live updates and background work provided by the platform. An agent reads the author's guide, builds a draft, shows a live preview, and publishes it for the signed-in person. This package connects your agent to Bunbird's two hosted MCP servers and teaches it the flow.

build.name: bunbird-build
build.summary: Builds with no account: read the guide, create a draft, build it, preview it.

account.name: bunbird
account.summary: Keeps and publishes for the signed-in person: save, list and resume drafts, publish.

defaultPrompts: Build me a small web app with Bunbird.
